blocks.text: Refresh your summer wardrobe with the Dokotoo Womens Summer Tops. This short sleeve tee features classic striped color block design, a comfy crewneck, and soft, lightweight fabric. Perfect for any casual occasion—work, vacation, or lounging at home—this top pairs effortlessly with your favorite jeans or shorts.

items.label: Features
items.value: Dokotoo womens summer tops feature with Striped, Color Block, Short Sleeve, Crewneck, Basic Tees for Women, Summer Tops for Women Trendy, Loose Relaxed Fit Tops, Slight Stretch, Casual and fashion style fits for any body shape, and a shirt necessary for women wardrobe.

items.label: Design
items.value: Striped color block t-shirts crewneck style and loose fit offer a blend of comfort and fashion. The chic color block design sets it apart, ensuring you stand out with effortless sophistication. Elevate your wardrobe with this versatile basic tee blouse that exudes casual charm and timeless appeal.

items.label: Material
items.value: Striped color block fashion t-shirt is made with high-quality fabric, breathable, lightweight, soft, durable, doesn't shrink or fade, friendly to skin, which will bring you a comfortable dressing experience. The soft fabric is gentle against your skin and easy to care for—simply machine wash cold and tumble dry low for hassle-free maintenance.

items.label: Match
items.value: Enhance your summer style effortlessly with Dokotoo's 2026 Striped Color Block Short Sleeve T-Shirt. Perfect for a casual day out, pair it with jeans, denim shorts, leggings, sneakers or heels for a laid-back and chic look. It pairs almost everything in your wardrobe, save you a lot time on making decisions.

items.label: Occasion
items.value: Casual basic womens tops is perfect choice for daily life, party, school, vacation, holiday, resort wear, beach, office, work, home, date, workout, outdoor activities and any other occasions. Perfect gift for mom,wife,daughter,girlfriend,or to your own.

items.label: Occasion Type
items.value: Casual Daily, Going Out, Vacation, Work, Workout
